question: Calcium and Magnesium are found in two health supplements, health supplement A and health supplement B. One serving of health supplement A contains 30 grams of Calcium and 50 grams of Magnesium. One serving of health supplement B contains 60 grams of Calcium and 10 grams of Magnesium. The cost per health supplement for health supplement A is $14 and the cost per health supplement for health supplement B is $25. A patient must consume these two health supplements every day to get at least 400 grams of Calcium and 50 grams of Magnesium. Determine how much servings of each supplement the patient needs to minimize her daily cost.

candidates.code:
import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "supplements": ["A", "B"],
    "nutrients": ["Calcium", "Magnesium"],
    # grams of each nutrient per serving of each supplement
    "calcium": {"A": 30, "B": 60},
    "magnesium": {"A": 50, "B": 10},
    # cost per serving (dollars)
    "cost": {"A": 14, "B": 25},
    # minimum daily requirements (grams)
    "calcium_req": 400,
    "magnesium_req": 50,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    supplements = d["supplements"]
    nutrients = d["nutrients"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Sets
    model.I = pyo.Set(initialize=supplements, doc="Supplement types")
    model.N = pyo.Set(initialize=nutrients, doc="Nutrients")

    # Nutrient content per serving, keyed (nutrient, supplement)
    content = {
        ("Calcium", i): d["calcium"][i] for i in supplements
    }
    content.update({("Magnesium", i): d["magnesium"][i] for i in supplements})
    requirement = {
        "Calcium": d["calcium_req"],
        "Magnesium": d["magnesium_req"],
    }

    # Decision variables: servings of each supplement (non-negative reals)
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.I, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                      doc="Servings of each supplement per day")

    # Objective: minimize total daily cost
    def cost_rule(m):
        return sum(d["cost"][i] * m.x[i] for i in m.I)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=cost_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Nutrient requirement constraints (one per nutrient)
    def nutrient_req_rule(m, n):
        return sum(content[(n, i)] * m.x[i] for i in m.I) >= requirement[n]

    model.nutrient_req = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=nutrient_req_rule)

    return model
